exposure: parental reporting of fine motor difficulties
cohort: The study included all live and stillbirths with a gestational age of 22+0 - 31+6 weeks from eight hospitals in Eastern Denmark in 2011-2012, with a sub-cohort of 141 extremely and 210 very preterm live-born children.
finding: At five years, parental reporting on fine motor skills was associated with fine and overall motor skills as assessed by professionals.
